lines.text: Such a wonderful breeze... Can you sense its rhythm?
Why do people always call me Jukebox?
Empty your mind. Be as free as the wind and the waters.
I wish you and I could stay on the surface and simply... drift. Like the breeze.

On the day I finish my journey,
will you come to hear me play once again?
I will never forget how you helped me find my love for music once again.
Um... Is it okay to play like this?

I will remember how relaxed I felt in this place, so full of atmosphere. And my anticipation...
 I will reproduce all of this when I play for you.
Let the wind carry you.
This place isn't nearly as restrictive as the Ark.
The acoustics in this Theater are fantastic! Perfect for playing.
Together on the battlefield, we will weave a masterful symphony!
I feel like I can play longer.
Such an overwhelming power... I can feel the melody emanating from it.
This is a big help... Thank you.
This makes me so happy!
What a lovely gift, it sends my heart into a crescendo!
A short sonatina, to express my joy.
No melody can express this restlessness I feel.
Can you hear the melody in my heart? It sings for you.
One day, I will let you hear the melody that lives inside me.
We can play a duet together.
Yes, Conductor.
I appreciate your advice.
I hear the sound of war drums.
The thrill of battle is undeniable.
I'm going to start playing.
I await your instructions, Conductor.
I have to make a few preparations.
I'm tuning my instrument.
Just a little luftpause.
Conductor!
This battle shall be my masterpiece!
And now for the chorus, with gusto!
The end.
Luck is on my side.
The power of music.
Ah, yes!
Uh.
Ow.
Now, we have come to the morendo...
What a wonderful denouement!
